messages.subject: regular citation format, not BibTeX please
parts:
Some of you may have noticed that we changed to a regular
bibliography format on the web (because BibTeX is unreadable):

http://mc-stan.org/citations/

I'll deal with these two, but in the future, please send papers
in something like the format on the above page. Or even better,
send a pull request vs. branch master on:

stan-dev/stan-dev.github.io/

with an updated citations/index.md file.

Thanks,

- Bob
